PublishedApp.title: PublishedApp
PublishedApp.description: Web application generated from a prompt and published online with a public slug URL.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier for the published app.

title.description: Human-readable title of the generated application.

summary.description: Concise summary of the application's purpose.

prompt.description: Natural language prompt used to generate or refine the application.

htmlCode.description: Complete self-contained HTML5/CSS/JS document for the application.

status.description: Operational availability status for public hosting.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

authorName.description: Public display name of the creator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the application was first published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

ConnectedApp.title: ConnectedApp
ConnectedApp.description: External or published application connected to OpenJarvis for live monitoring, control, and command dispatch.

id.description: Unique identifier for the connected application record.

name.description: Display name of the connected application.

appType.description: Integration type for the connected application.

baseUrl.description: Base URL or relative /p/ slug path for the connected application.

healthPath.description: Endpoint path checked during live connection pings.

defaultMethod.description: Default HTTP method when dispatching commands.

description.description: Operational description so the user and OpenJarvis understand what the app does.

status.description: Whether the connection is active or paused.

lastCheckStatus.description: Result of the latest connectivity check.

lastCheckedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest connectivity check.

linkedPublishedSlug.description: Optional slug linking to a published OpenJarvis app.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the connection was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

RouterProfile.title: RouterProfile
RouterProfile.description: Private router connection profile, simplified network settings, and diagnostic summary (zero passwords stored).

id.description: Unique identifier for the router profile.

hostUrl.description: Management endpoint URL or IP address (optional for snapshot-only diagnostics).

adminUsername.description: Administrator username (password/key is never persisted in Firestore).

authScheme.description: Authentication method expected by the router admin endpoint.

lastHttpCode.description: Latest HTTP status observed from router endpoint.

lastDiagnosticHealth.description: Overall simplified health verdict from diagnostics.

lastDiagnosticSummary.description: Plain-language summary of the latest router diagnostic.

dnsProtection.description: Simplified DNS speed and family protection mode.

guestWifiEnabled.description: Whether a separate guest Wi-Fi network is enabled.

autoOptimizeChannel.description: Whether automatic Wi-Fi interference channel selection is enabled.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the router owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the router profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/published_apps/{appId}.description: Stores published prompt-generated web applications keyed by URL slug.

/connected_apps/{appId}.description: Stores private user-configured application connections and operational control metadata.

/router_profiles/{profileId}.description: Stores private user router profiles, simplified network configuration, and diagnostic summaries.
